cues.name: attract_bed
cues.trigger: starts when the machine is armed and empty; stops the instant a car enters the carriage
cues.notes: 12.0 s seamless loop, 1.50 s wrap crossfade

cues.name: hoist_loop
cues.trigger: car secured in carriage; play for the ~6 s of the 43 m rise. Pitch 1.0 during the climb, ramp pitch 1.0->0.72 over the last 1.2 s for the decelerating approach
cues.notes: 2.0 s seamless loop, motor f0 44 Hz, 6.5 links/s

cues.name: hoist_settle
cues.trigger: fires as the hoist loop is stopped, at the top of the 43 m rise; matches a decelerating arrival
cues.notes: motor spin-down + decelerating chain + seat clunk + brake

cues.name: gate_open
cues.trigger: crown gate unlatches, once the carriage has settled
cues.notes: solenoid + pneumatic + sliding leaf + end-stop clank

cues.name: kicker_impulse
cues.trigger: the kicker impulse that throws the car onto the chute
cues.notes: 105->38 Hz sub drop + pneumatic + 145 Hz plate ring + slam

cues.name: chute_slide
cues.trigger: loop while the car is on the 40 deg chute; drive volume and pitch from chute speed, stop on first pin contact
cues.notes: 3.0 s seamless loop, resonances at 620 / 1250 Hz

cues.name: yokoku_t1
cues.trigger: anticipation tier 1; fire as the car clears the gate once the runtime has rolled the tier for this play
cues.notes: bell f0 660 Hz, pulse 4->5 Hz, band 300-4500 Hz

cues.name: yokoku_t2
cues.trigger: anticipation tier 2; fire as the car clears the gate once the runtime has rolled the tier for this play
cues.notes: bell f0 825 Hz, pulse 6->8 Hz, band 175-7000 Hz

cues.name: yokoku_t3
cues.trigger: anticipation tier 3; fire as the car clears the gate once the runtime has rolled the tier for this play
cues.notes: bell f0 990 Hz, pulse 8->14 Hz, band 85-11000 Hz

cues.name: yokoku_t4
cues.trigger: anticipation tier 4; fire as the car clears the gate once the runtime has rolled the tier for this play
cues.notes: bell f0 1320 Hz, pulse 12->23 Hz, band 30-17500 Hz

cues.name: reach_loop
cues.trigger: loop under the fall for as long as the car is live in the pin field -- Risset glissando, so it rises forever without ever restarting. Stop it the frame the bin is known
cues.notes: 2.0 s seamless loop, 6-voice Risset from 55 Hz

cues.name: reach_win
cues.trigger: the fall is going to score: swap to this the moment the runtime commits to a scoring bin, ~1 row before the base
cues.notes: 3.2 s riser resolving to a C major bloom on the bell family

cues.name: reach_fail
cues.trigger: the fall is going to miss: the riser is cut off and sags
cues.notes: same 3.2 s riser, resolves to a dry mechanical nothing

cues.name: payout_small
cues.trigger: car settles in the 400 or 800 bin
cues.notes: vintage cabinet only -- bells + arcade blips, band-limited to 200 Hz - 6.5 kHz

cues.name: payout_medium
cues.trigger: car settles in the 1500 or 3000 bin
cues.notes: bells + koto run + taiko + a short synth-brass swell; the band opens to 11 kHz -- the machine steps forward a decade

cues.name: payout_jackpot
cues.trigger: car settles in the centre JACKPOT bin (10000)
cues.notes: orchestral-style hit, G-C-E-G fanfare, taiko roll, 46-note bell cascade, second hit at 3.60 s

cues.name: concede
cues.trigger: after the last knocker rap fails to free the car; the machine gives up the ball and re-arms
cues.notes: relay drop-out, motor coast-down, falling minor third, reset solenoid. Peak sits 7 dB below the payouts on purpose

cues.name: knocker_1
cues.trigger: knocker rap 1 of 4; fire in sequence, ~0.9 s apart, once the car has been hung up on the pins for about 2 s
cues.notes: hammer f0 182 Hz, brightness 0.40, peak -16.0 dBFS

cues.name: knocker_2
cues.trigger: knocker rap 2 of 4; fire in sequence, ~0.9 s apart, once the car has been hung up on the pins for about 2 s
cues.notes: hammer f0 196 Hz, brightness 0.60, peak -11.0 dBFS

cues.name: knocker_3
cues.trigger: knocker rap 3 of 4; fire in sequence, ~0.9 s apart, once the car has been hung up on the pins for about 2 s
cues.notes: hammer f0 210 Hz, brightness 0.80, peak -6.5 dBFS

cues.name: knocker_4
cues.trigger: knocker rap 4 of 4; fire in sequence, ~0.9 s apart, once the car has been hung up on the pins for about 2 s
cues.notes: hammer f0 224 Hz, brightness 1.00, peak -2.5 dBFS
